data.name: Funny Rummy
data.detailed_description:
Surreal rummy where rules get twisted...

Funny Rummy is a roguelike deckbuilder built on rummy. Draft cards, arrange your hand into the best configuration you can manage, and score enough to survive the round. Play runs, sets, flushes, and a few combinations that don't exist in any rummy game you've played before. Also, you only get one round to discard, so make it count.

The goal score goes up every round, the dream ends when you can't keep up.

Visit the Junk Drawer between rounds
Between rounds, you'll find yourself at the Junk Drawer. Add cards to your deck, cut the ones you don't need, and pick up items that change how the whole table plays. Junk Drawer items include:

  • Passive table items that shift your scoring multipliers toward specific meld types and open up new strategies. 

  • Wild cards with individual powers that make forming melds easier and introduce a secondary layer of decisions around when and how to use then.

  • "Sub-suit" cards that give each suit its own identity and style of play through discovery.  

Funny Rummy Features

  • Rummy-based hand scoring: Runs, Sets, Flushes, and meld types unique to Funny Rummy

  • Four drafts per round to build your hand, with a single round to discard. 

  • Peek the deck and use the discard pile to weigh the odds when drafting cards.

  • Deck management between every round. View your full deck, add cards, remove cards, adjust your table items.

  • Add table items, wild cards, and sub-suit cards that combine in synergistic ways

  • Begin with a 40-card deck and 12-card hand limit to start. 

  • Escalating score targets with "infinite mode" for high scores.

data.short_description: This table feels familiar... the rest of it? A little funny. Funny Rummy is a rummy-based roguelike deckbuilder where the rules make sense, the combos don't, and the dream ends if you don't hit your score.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (2015 or later)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (all Macs 2012+)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio
  • Additional Notes: Supports Apple Silicon and Intel
